sar.narrative: This suspicious activity report details fraud involving customer C13487, card C13487-K1, and online transactions conducted between November 15, 2016, and November 26, 2016. The illicit activity was carried out through the online channel using an unusual device profile identified as 'SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080' connected via an anonymous proxy in billing region 191, accumulating a total exposure amount of $439.61 across 3 affected transactions (IDs 3460634, 3478561, and 3489320). The scheme was executed by routing transactions through a shared device that was marked new on all uses and linked to 27 other cards as well as confirmed closed cases CC-2985, CC-2971, CC-2649, and CC-3035. This activity is suspicious because it forms part of a coordinated, undocumented shared-device ring utilizing anonymous proxies to compromise multiple accounts. Actions taken include blocking the card (route L1, recommended pending approval due to exposure <= $2,500 and high fraud probability), creating a case automatically, filing a report (route L2, recommended pending approval per policy 3a, R6, R9), monitoring connected cards automatically, and escalating to an analyst automatically for wider scheme review.
